import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user

from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")

    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:

    return CurrentUser(

        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )

import os
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass

import httpx
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import User, WebSession

TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://login.ledgerly.app/oauth2/token"
USERINFO_ENDPOINT = "https://login.ledgerly.app/oauth2/userinfo"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Identity:
    email: str
    subject: str


async def exchange_code(code: str, verifier: str) -> Identity:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:
        token = await client.post(
            TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
            data={
                "grant_type": "authorization_code",
                "code": code,
                "code_verifier": verifier,
                "client_id": os.environ["SSO_CLIENT_ID"],
                "client_secret": os.environ["SSO_CLIENT_SECRET"],
            },
        )
        token.raise_for_status()
        info = await client.get(USERINFO_ENDPOINT, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token.json()['access_token']}"})
        info.raise_for_status()
    body = info.json()
    return Identity(email=body["email"], subject=body["sub"])


async def start_web_session(session: AsyncSession, identity: Identity) -> str:
    user = await session.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == identity.email.lower()))
    if user is None:
        raise PermissionError("no account for this identity")
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    session.add(WebSession(token=token, user_id=user.id, ttl_seconds=43200))
    await session.commit()
    return token

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/auth/token")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CurrentUser:
    id: int
    email: str
    role: str
    tenant_slug: str
    account_id: int


async def get_current_user(token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)]) -> CurrentUser:
    try:
        claims = jwt.decode(token, os.environ["JWT_SIGNING_KEY"], algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api")
    except jwt.PyJWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token") from exc
    return CurrentUser(
        id=int(claims["sub"]),
        email=claims["email"],
        role=claims.get("role", "member"),
        tenant_slug=claims["tenant"],
        account_id=int(claims["acct"]),
    )


async def require_admin(user: Annotated[CurrentUser, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> CurrentUser:
    if user.role != "admin":
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "admin only")
    return user
